integrity: The proof separates the analytic theorem from a finite numerical stress test. No finite computation is used as a proof of the infinite-dimensional statement, and no independence or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is a linear invasion theorem at the predator-free state. It does not establish global extinction/persistence, full basin geometry, or monotonicity in the maturation age \(\tau^*\). Infinite-lifespan semigroup exponential stability requires standard additional tail hypotheses; the finite-lifespan numerical specialization avoids this issue.
title: Juvenile consumption creates a unique predator-invasion cutoff
